Name: The bachelor of English language program_Chương trình cử nhân Ngôn ngữ Anh
English Name: The bachelor of English language program

PLOs.Name: PLO1
PLOs.Description: Demonstrate basic knowledge of social sciences, politics, law, and national defense and security, contributing to the formation of worldview and scientific methodology.

PLOs.Name: PLO2
PLOs.Description: Demonstrate the mindset and ability to implement start-up projects, creative spirits, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

PLOs.Name: PLO3
PLOs.Description: Communicate and work in groups effectively in academic and practical environments.

PLOs.Name: PLO4
PLOs.Description: Utilize English in communication and learning and be able to communicate simply in Chinese, equivalent to elementary level.

PLOs.Name: PLO5
PLOs.Description: Demonstrate professional behaviours, ethicalness, social responsibilities, and willingness to serve the community.

PLOs.Name: PLO6
PLOs.Description: Cultivate strong mental and physical health, express national identity, and be confident in global integration.

PLOs.Name: PLO7
PLOs.Description: Develop self-study and lifelong learning skills and capabilities to adapt to the constant change of technology and society.

PLOs.Name: PLO8
PLOs.Description: Demonstrate language capacity in 4 skills: Listening, Speaking, Reading, Writing fluently and achieve language proficiency in level 5 according to the 6-level Foreign Language Proficiency Framework for Vietnam or equivalent to level C1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) to serve effectively for academic, social, and professional purposes.

PLOs.Name: PLO9
PLOs.Description: Apply language competence, together with research, synthesis, analysis and evaluation of data and information skills in learning and professional work, solving problems in a range of written/spoken forms.

PLOs.Name: PLO10
PLOs.Description: Recognize and understand basic knowledge and characteristics of people, cultures customs and behaviours; and apply the knowledge to studying, working and multicultural environments.

PLOs.Name: PLO11
PLOs.Description: Demonstrate abilities to apply basic and in-depth knowledge of levels and aspects of the English language to study and professional practice, and know how to approach and analyse English literatures.

PLOs.Name: PLO12
PLOs.Description: Demonstrate understanding the professional characteristics and the required knowledge, capacity, attitudes and qualities for professions in various fields and career orientations related to the use of English such as interpreting and translation, teaching, communication, international business, etc.

PLOs.Name: PLO13
PLOs.Description: Apply language and professional knowledge and skills, and interdisciplinary knowledge of culture, economy, politics, society and science to study and work with professional attitude and manners.
